hook.text: A job applicant is rejected because of their accent—not their qualifications. It happens every day.

buildup.text: Linguistic discrimination means treating people unfairly based on how they speak.

discovery.text: It affects hiring, housing, education, and legal proceedings across many countries.

twist.text: Unlike racial discrimination, linguistic discrimination is rarely illegal—and often seen as acceptable.

climax.text: Linguist Rosina Lippi-Green argues this is the last 'acceptable' form of discrimination.

punchline.text: Judging someone's competence by their accent is prejudice in disguise.

quiz.question: What is linguistic discrimination?
options: Treating people unfairly based on how they speak
